'''DecipherCon 1999 Squadron Members Sealed Deck''' was an informal sealed deck event that [[Squadron Members]] working at [[DecipherCon 1999]] held for themselves late on Saturday 13 November 1999, after the day's events, at the Cavalier Hotel in Virginia Beach, Virginia. [[Alex Alcalde]] put the turnout at 28 Squadron Members, adding "i think".<ref name="cec-dc4">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon4.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.4], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030108/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon4.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' Saturday 13 November 1999, from about 11:30 p.m. until about 3 a.m.<ref name="cec-dc2">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon2.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.2], Jeff Alexander, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030058/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia (the hotel's top floor)
* '''Format:''' [[Players' Choice Sealed Deck]], from OTSDs and packs<ref name="cec-dc2" /><ref name="cec-dc4" />

== Players ==

The players met in the lobby at 11:30 p.m., agreed on the format, and took over the top floor. [[Kevin Reitzel]] of Decipher came up with Japanese packs and a trivia contest.<ref name="cec-dc2" /> No results were posted.
